lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏥᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
lines.text: Gi-la-quo-no i-yv-dv du-ni-yo-se tsi-yu a-le u-ni-do-da, a-le gv-wa-s-da-wa-dv-se-i.
lines.english: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
lines.emitted_text: khilakwunho iyvta tuniyohsi tsiyu'ale v unitota v ale kvwahstakwatvlhe'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏫᏍᎨ ᏧᎵᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎲᎢ.
lines.text: Tsi-sa-no ni-gv-na-dv Ge-li-li e-do-he-i da-de-yo-hv-s-ge tsu-ni-la-wi-i-s-di-yi, a-le a-li-tsi-do-hv-s-ge o-s-dv ka-no-he-dv, U-ne-la-nv-hi u-gv-wi-yu-hi ge-sv ka-no-he-s-ge-i, a-le de-ka-nv-wi-s-ge tsu-li-le-nv-dv du-ni-tlv-gv-i, a-le tsu-da-le-nv-dv v-yu-gi yv-wi u-ne-hv-i.
lines.english: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
lines.emitted_text: tsihsanho v nikvnathv kelali etohe'i tateyhohvhske tsunilawihstiyi v ale alhtsatohvhske ohsta khanoheta unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehske'i ale tekhanvwihske tsutalenhvta tunitlvkv'i i ohi ulvtsutalenhvta'v yuki yvwi unehv'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎤᏰᎵᏎᎢ; ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᏃᏘᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏍᎩ; ᏚᏅᏩᏁᏃ.
lines.text: De-ga-no-tsa-lv-no ni-gv-na-dv Si-li-yi u-ye-li-se-i; de-gv-wa-ti-no-he-le-no ni-ga-dv tsu-ni-tlv-gi, tsu-da-le-nv-dv v-yu-gi a-le e-hi-s-di u-ni-yi-li-do-hi, a-le na-s-quo a-ni-s-gi-na di-gv-wa-ni-ya-i, a-le na-s-quo tsu-ni-lv-no-ti-s-gi, a-le na-s-quo tsu-ni-na-wi-s-gi; du-nv-wa-ne-no.
lines.english: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
lines.emitted_text: tikanotsalhvnho nikvnathv siliyi v uyelihse'i tikvwahthinohelenho nikata tsunitlvki i vv tsutalinhvta' yuki ale ehihsti uni'ilitohi alenahskwu anihskina tikvwaniya'i alenvhskwu tsunilvnhohtihski alenahskwu tsuninawihski tunhvwanenhoh

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ-ᎦᏚᎩᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ.
lines.text: U-ni-tsa-ti-no yv-wi gv-wa-s-da-wa-dv-se-i nv-da-yu-ni-lo-sv-hi ge-li-li, A-s-go-hi-no--Ga-du-gi-yi, a-le Tsi-lu-si-li-mi, a-le Tsu-di-yi, a-le Tso-da-ni s-go-ni-di-tlv.
lines.english: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
